summary: First-pass full testing of Vitrina Automotriz (Chilean workshop finder). Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passed (categories, workshops list, featured, category filter, search, detail by id, 404, comunas). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): home loads with brand title, search, 10 category chips, featured carousel, workshops list; chip filter, 250ms debounced search, workshop row → detail navigation, favorite toggle, Categorías tab (9 tiles) → filtered workshops list, Favoritos tab, Info tab (WhatsApp/Portal/Facebook/Instagram) all functional. Bottom tab bar renders 4 tabs (Inicio/Categorías/Favoritos/Info). No red screen, no page errors, no 500s.

issues: Deprecation console warnings: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be migrated for future RN Web releases.

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated 'shadow*' StyleSheet props to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Seed logic is idempotent (only seeds when collection empty).
CORS is open (*) — acceptable for this public catalogue app but confirm before production.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (correct Expo convention). No hardcoded URLs observed in tested paths.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend auto-seeds 12 workshops on startup (verified: /api/workshops returns >= 12).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend backend URL env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Categoría tile testID is 'cat-tile-{key}' (not 'category-tile-*'). Detail screen testIDs: workshop-detail, detail-back, detail-favorite, action-call, action-whatsapp, action-directions, action-web, contact-phone, contact-email, contact-address, cta-contact. Bottom tabs: tab-home, tab-categorias, tab-favoritos, tab-info.
